digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend facade and adapter interface
propositions: A backend-agnostic `Backend` facade with five role Protocols (`TicketTransport`, `OutboundMapper`, `InboundMapper`, `FieldSanitizer`, `IdentityConvention`) and three runtime-checkable capability Protocols must be defined to abstract the Jira adapter.
The `RemoteRef` dataclass with vendor, instance, and remote_id fields must be introduced as the canonical identity type per ADR 0035 §(d).
A thin `JiraBackend` wrapper must delegate to existing Jira modules (AcliClient, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields, comment_limits) with zero behavior change and pure delegation only.
The `IdentityConvention` pure convention object must encode/decode the `rebar-id:{remote_id}` label format as a new self-contained module under adapters/jira/ without rewiring core call sites.

A backend-agnostic contract test suite must validate outbound-to-inbound round-trips, sanitizer idempotence, identity encoding/decoding, and capability-gated dispatch via isinstance checks against both JiraBackend (with injected mock transport) and FakeBackend.
Characterization tests must assert byte-for-byte identity of pure Jira mapper outputs (outbound map, text fit, inbound extract) against pre-story main to prove delegation preservation of behavior.
